item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero Season 4 Episode 14
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler, and not only about this episode.

I watched Re:Zero season 4 episode 14 twice. I didn't expect that ending.

So, in this episode, I was able to understand a lot of things. First of all, if Subaru, Ram, and Beatrice rushed to Emilia's place, Shaula turned into a scorpion. Why did that happen to her? It was probably a spell her master cast on her in the past, one that would turn her into a mabeast if she went outside of the tower, in order to stop her from abandoning the tower. So I bet while she was protecting the tower on the balcony, something pushed her and she became the mabeast.

Then Subaru got a new authority, which let him see the colors of some characters' souls, and see where they were, I guess. For some reason, the souls he could recognize were the ones close to him — Ram, Rem, Patrasche, Shaula, Foxidna, and so on — but he couldn't recognize others like Gluttony, a lot of mabeasts, or Reid. Why did he get this authority now? I have no idea. And he got it right before Shaula's scorpion appeared, and before the witch did. And why did the witch come here? I have no idea. It's probably related to why Shaula fell. And Subaru didn't remember what happened after the witch came, which implied to me that he became the Archbishop again at that time, and died.

Then Gluttony was able to take Emilia's name if they got to her place too late. And also, if they didn't stop Reid, he met up with Gluttony too, and the battle turned into chaos. When it comes to Gluttony, he used a few techniques and he also spoke in a few ways. It was obviously because he ate a lot of people's memories and gained their experience. He didn't share his memories with the Gluttony in the book, though, because he thought Subaru still had his memories. It was funny to see when he was trying to imitate Rem's behavior, honestly. The voice actor did his best with that. It was patently clear that Ram was furious with Gluttony too, because her memories of Rem had been taken by him. His authority showed some weaknesses when Ram lost her memories of Emilia, because her memories no longer added up when she lost her memories of both Rem and Emilia. Then the cliffhanger at the end was that Reid Astrea was one of the Gluttonies. This was the most surprising thing to me in this episode and I even let out a noise at the end on my first watch. I was wondering why he didn't help defeat Gluttony, or why Gluttony came into the tower in the first place, but this made it clear. Also, when I watched it the second time, I noticed he hadn't lost his memories of Emilia, and also Subaru couldn't recognize his soul at all, so I should've been able to figure it out. But then, why did he beat the other Gluttony up that badly? Anyhow, this explained why there was a Gluttony in his book in the archive.

This episode's subtitle was "Five Obstacles". What are they? At least from what I've seen, there are a few candidates.

  1. Mabeasts from the sand dunes
  2. Gluttony 1st
  3. Shaula's scorpion
  4. The Witch
  5. Reid Astrea
  6. Subaru turning into an Archbishop

And then, I believe another Archbishop who pushed Subaru with Rem's voice was there, too. But this may not count because it's not something Subaru has seen so far and maybe just how the animation was done. I think these have to be overcome in this arc. I think at least, this arc will end the battle against Gluttony, and may solve some of the issues they currently have, like Rem, Julius, and Subaru. This should also show how Subaru can overcome a crazy strong enemy, a Sword Saint like Reinhard. I don't know what will happen with Anastasia's problem, though.

Scores

  • Episode: 9/10
  • Subaru: 7/10
    • His new authority, and the way he handled the situation, were good
  • Emilia: 7/10
    • She was an independent and emotional person so she was overjoyed when Subaru remembered her though her name had been taken.
  • Ram: 8/10
    • Her joke was good, especially the one about Emilia in this episode, that Emilia has only a few good points, and one of them is her face.
    • Her kindness made her very angry at Gluttony.
  • Gluttony (Lye Batenkaitos): 5/10
  • Reid Astrea: 6/10
    • The voice actor is good. But why was he a Gluttony?

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero Season 4 Episode 13
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler, and not only about this episode.

I watched Re:Zero season 4 episode 13 twice. "That is that, this is this."

I think it made sense how other people like Julius felt toward Subaru. Subaru spoke like he knew Julius pretty well, even though Subaru had said he lost his memory the day before. It sounded like a lie, but he was on his fifth life because of the return by death, and he saw how Julius confronted Reid by himself in a desperate situation. Honestly, if I were Julius, I would think he was lying for some reason, or just a creepy person. But Julius trusted him and believed his words, and also he had his pride as a knight. So he looked like he was convinced by what Subaru said.

Before they reached the archive, Emilia's expressions toward Subaru changed a lot, too. She is the main heroine, so she was given priority in the animation. For example, when he replied to what she said with "that's not something you hear these days", she broke into a big smile. But then, when he thought he should be the one to check Reid's book, she was worried though other people had already made up their minds about the consequences.

Speaking of the conversation in the archive, it was a bit of a long conversation before he opened the book, at least that was what I thought when I watched it the first time. That was... maybe because he was afraid of losing his memories again, and also he cared about the others who were worried about him, like Emilia and Beako.

And I was wondering how the tower got overrun by monsters in Subaru's previous lives, but now we have an idea, thanks to this episode. Gluttony — the big brothers — invaded the tower successfully. Maybe partially because Shaula was with Subaru and she didn't notice them sooner. And the reason why they were able to attack so early was... what? We know that there are multiple Gluttonies, and it looked like they shared their memories, because they all had Rem's memories. So I guess they shared memories, and when the Gluttony sister in the Corridor of Memories ate Subaru's memory, they knew where Subaru and the others were, too? Shaula's protective magic for the tower, Infinite Hell Snipe, also had a very long and wide range, but it wasn't enough to exterminate all the mabeasts, so plenty of them got inside.

In terms of Subaru and Gluttony in the Corridor of Memories, from their conversation, I felt that was the plot the author wanted to write. Subaru used to return by death a lot, but he never lost his memory, or died completely. So it was an agonizing moment: he wanted to protect himself, while Gluttony was trying to trap him into strangling her and splitting him apart. She wanted to be dead. This was my understanding from what she said. Well, Subaru agonized throughout this series MANY times so this was the Nth time for us to watch this kind of scene.

One thing I didn't understand was why Gluttony couldn't see or notice Rem. Apparently, she showed up because Gluttony had to pull her memories out and throw them away in order to eat Subaru's memory — her memory of him stopped them from doing so. But does that mean they can't perceive anything they throw away? Or maybe, this is another thing only Subaru can do, like his Witch's curse.

By the way, I knew Rem was in this episode because I'd seen a spoiler, but I wouldn't have expected her if I hadn't known it. I had forgotten but she was strict with Subaru, so I didn't expect her to speak so harshly when they met. But she saw him as a hero and never wavered on that. What was the effect Subaru received before she disappeared? After that, he became positive and optimistic. Did his memory come back at that point, or did it remind him of Emilia or other people in the tower in his previous lives? Also, her memory orb was lost in the corridor, so does that mean her memories are completely lost? Or do the other Gluttonies still have her memories, so they could be recovered? Maybe that's the case, and she will not remember what happened there because that memory didn't exist in the other Gluttonies' memories. Subaru thought he could meet her again. In the worst case, considering that the Corridor of Memories is the place to "filter" souls, maybe she was "filtered" this time. Well, but in this series, nobody has died for good, right? So that seems very unlikely.

And we know a little about Gluttony now. It's weird that she could split into two, but at least that's an ability she has. And because there is a book that leads to the Corridor of Memories, I feel in season 4, they will defeat Gluttony. I also saw another spoiler that Emilia will be forgotten, so defeating them and recovering the memories will be important, too. Besides, I think Julius will defeat Reid to get his spirits back. So I think that will be the next episode.

Scores

  • Episode: 8/10
  • Subaru: 7/10
    • He believed what Gluttony said too easily, even though he knew she had eaten his memories. But at the same time, this was a mysterious world so I can empathize with him worrying that he might disappear.
    • He often agonized and showed an unsightly side of himself, like trying to work out from others how he should behave.
  • Julius: 8/10
    • He is cool and straightforward. He trusted Subaru a lot, maybe because he took a liking to him at first sight.
  • Rem: 9/10
    • It's been a while since we've seen her in the series. For that alone, it should be worth 10/10 honestly.
    • This time, she was the person who pointed Subaru in the right direction, again. What a dedicated person. She believed him too much, but she might have found out he can return by death at that time.
    • Her cool voice and her caring words for Subaru are good.
  • Gluttony: 6/10
    • They're disgusting characters but now this character is a good villain. We now know their motivation is to become happy and for that, they steal other people's happy memories.
    • Their words sometimes hit on the truth, too.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero Season 4 Episode 12
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 12 twice.

So, Re:Zero season 4 was one of the most anticipated seasons I'd waited for. It started after Subaru returned by death 4 times in a short period of time in the tower of... What? Saint? And in the previous loop, he distrusted everyone because he was killed 3 times, but then he noticed everyone was really worried about him and he also was saved by Emilia from disappearing. So, it was pretty natural that he broke down in tears when he came back and saw Beatrice was alive. I forgot how she died in the previous loop, though. I remembered Meili, Foxidna, Julius, and Emilia.

The first thing he had to decide was how to handle his amnesia, and he decided to come clean about it. Honestly, he was very fluent while he was talking about his amnesia, so I felt the same way as Ram. He was too confident and suspicious. It still felt off to me that she cared about Rem a lot though she didn't have any memories of Rem. But considering that nobody but Subaru remembers Rem, Ram was relying on him when it came to Rem, who was supposed to be her sister, and someone Ram would have taken care of a lot, perhaps. Anyhow, Subaru communicated perfectly with Ram and made her believe he lost his memory. She had a sharp tongue as usual, but she trusted Subaru for sure because he cared about Rem and didn't give up. The animation of Ram slapping Subaru, somehow drawn from three angles, was... what? Maybe trying to show an unexpected, surprising thing. I liked how Ram looked down at Subaru after that scene.

Then there was another problem: someone had tried to kill Subaru. And he probably had figured out that it was Meili. Well, it was obvious, because who else? Obviously, no way Emilia, Beatrice, Ram, Rem, Julius, or Foxidna. So the only candidate was Shaula, which was unlikely because she seemed to be too straightforward a person. But I didn't realize she killed him because of Elsa. And I had already forgotten, but Subaru saw her past in the archive room, so he knew a lot about her. She was like a wild animal, and was raised by Elsa. So, as a wild animal, it didn't make sense that someone who had tried to kill a person would be forgiven by that person for no clear reason. So she hit the panic button, and tried to kill herself. Well, I didn't really sympathize with her throughout this episode or in the past. Anyhow, Meili was also forgiven by everyone else after Subaru explained her situation to them. Everyone seemed to trust Subaru too much at this point, so it felt a little off. But they may have thought that even without his memory, Subaru was a dependable guy, and they trusted what he said.

Then, Subaru suggested putting off looking for a solution to his amnesia. It felt a little off to me, but I noticed he wanted to make sure he wasn't left out of the trial with Reid, so that he could see what would happen, or what had happened in the previous loops. Also, he made a convincing argument, and Foxidna agreed with it. He was definitely still smart.

What will happen in the next episode? Probably another battle against Reid. And how will they win against him?

Scores

  • Episode: 7/10
  • Subaru: 8/10
    • I have no idea why Subaru remembered how to use a whip
  • Emilia: 7/10
    • She looked sad when she realized he had really lost his memory, because he called her by a different name
    • She trusted Subaru, a lot
  • Ram: 7/10
    • Her usual sense of humor, and caring about Rem, even though she has already forgotten who Rem is
  • Meili: 4/10
    • She needs to learn how to behave from someone, because her past experiences were so wild
    • I couldn't sympathize with her, but she's still good
  • Elsa: 6/10
    • Did she really mean that she was tickled when Meili bit her and she was bleeding?
